results.description: KATHMANDU — Prime Minister Balendra Shah (Balen) returned to Kathmandu on Monday evening, concluding his two-day official state visit to India—his first bilateral foreign trip since assuming office. Arriving at Tribhuvan International Airport after being seen off in New Delhi by Indian Minister of State for Commerce and Industry Jitin Prasada, Shah wrapped up a high-level diplomatic tour marked by the signing of eight Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs), new cross-border connectivity launches, and a fresh economic vision between the two neighbors.
